# Clipo

> Clipo is a screen recorder for product demos that runs entirely in the browser. It finds the creator's cursor in every frame of the recording, works out which controls were clicked, and moves the camera to them automatically, so one take becomes a demo people can follow. There is nothing to install and no browser extension. Credits are bought once and never expire. There is no subscription.

A browser's screen capture hands over pixels and nothing else: no cursor position, no clicks, no record of what was pressed. Most auto-zoom recorders get around that with a desktop app or an extension that logs the mouse. Clipo does not. It reads the pointer and the presses back out of the recording itself, then builds the camera moves from them.

## What a creator gets

### Record in the browser
- Record a tab, a window or the whole screen, straight from the browser
- Nothing to install and no extension to approve

### The pointer, found in every frame
- The cursor is matched by its shape, at the size and design the creator's machine actually draws
- A cursor inside a video playing on the page is recognised as somebody else's and left alone

### Clicks, worked out from the picture
- A press is weighed from the pointer's approach, the interface acknowledging it, and what changed on screen afterwards
- A hand resting on a link is not a click, and a page scrolling under a still cursor is not a click

### Camera moves built around the control
- Each zoom is framed on the control that was pressed rather than a single coordinate, so the whole thing stays in shot
- The camera arrives before the press and leaves once the result is on screen

### An editor for every decision
- Each camera move is an object on a timeline with a position, a level and a curve: drag it, retime it, delete it, or add one
- The cursor path is redrawn and smoothed
- Steps are read out of the recording, and captions are burned into the final file

### Output in the shape it has to land in
- 16:9 for product tours, 9:16 for launch clips, 1:1 for feature updates, and GIF

## Pricing

- No subscription and nothing recurring. Credits are bought once and never expire
- New accounts start with 100 free credits
- Starter: Rs 199 for 250 credits
- Creator: Rs 499 for 700 credits
- Studio: Rs 999 for 1600 credits
- Analysing a recording and exporting a video are charged by the minute, and the cost is shown before anything is charged
- Payments are in Indian Rupees through Razorpay

## Who it is for

- Founders and product teams recording demos, launch videos and feature updates
- Support and customer success teams making walkthroughs
- Anyone who wants a polished, zoomed demo without installing a desktop recorder

## Ownership and control

- Creators own their recordings and every video Clipo renders from them
- Recordings are uploaded and analysed on Clipo's servers. Sampled frames are read by Google Gemini to work out the steps; the rest is measured from the pixels
- Recordings and their renders can be deleted at any time, and deleting removes the source file too

## Company

Clipo is a product of Betafounder Enterprises, Hyderabad, India. It was previously called Lipi (trylipi.online).
